concept.name: Noodlehead
concept.tagline: Thai street food noodles in Shadyside, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Street Noodle 1
menu.description: Rice noodles with Thai fried chicken, Chinese broccoli, bean sprouts, cilantro, and a sweet and tangy lime juice sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of rice noodles topped with crispy Thai fried chicken, Chinese broccoli, bean sprouts, and cilantro, in a clear plastic bowl with a lid and paper bag

menu.name: Street Noodle 2
menu.description: Thin egg noodles with tempura shrimp, Chinese broccoli, bean sprouts, cilantro, and soy and lime sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of thin egg noodles with golden tempura shrimp, Chinese broccoli, bean sprouts, and cilantro, in a clear plastic bowl with a lid and paper bag

menu.name: Pad Thai
menu.description: Rice noodles with your choice of chicken, shrimp, tofu, or vegetables, egg, bean sprouts, peanuts, scallions, and tamarind sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of pad thai rice noodles with egg, bean sprouts, crushed peanuts, and scallions, in a foil tray with a lid and paper bag

menu.name: Green Curry
menu.description: A rich and creamy green curry with sweet peppers, eggplant, broccoli, and green beans, served with white rice.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of creamy green curry with eggplant, peppers, broccoli, and green beans beside a mound of white rice, in a sealed plastic container with a paper bag

menu.name: Kapow Basil
menu.description: Thai basil stir-fry with garlic, peppers, chilies, and a fried egg, served with white rice.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of Thai basil stir-fry with peppers, chilies, and a fried egg over white rice, in a foil tray with a lid and paper bag

menu.name: Khao Mun Fried Chicken
menu.description: Fried chicken in a light, flavorful chicken broth with sweet and sour sauce, served with white rice.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of fried chicken in light broth beside white rice, with a small cup of sweet and sour sauce, in a sealed container with a paper bag

menu.name: Duck Noodle Soup
menu.description: Rice noodles with tender duck in a herbal broth, Chinese broccoli, bean sprouts, and a hint of spice.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout soup container of rice noodles with tender duck slices, Chinese broccoli, and bean sprouts in herbal broth, with a sealed lid and paper bag

menu.name: Thai Iced Tea
menu.imagePrompt: A tall plastic cup of orange Thai iced tea with a straw and lid, in a takeout drink carrier

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark of a steaming noodle bowl with chopsticks forming a simple head silhouette, in red and dark brown on cream.
brand.voice: Friendly and casual, like a neighborhood street market stall that's happy to help you pick your bowl.
